scope: CVG-003 bounded account-scoped discharge collection, detail, update and repository lookup/delete boundary

criteria.description: DischargesService keeps hydrated rows in a shared map while detail/update/encounter methods and repository lookup/delete contracts permit missing account context.
criteria.limitations: The gate covers the local application/repository boundary; existing database RLS and the controller's later account check do not replace a required service contract.

criteria.description: The authorized correction is limited to explicit AccountId propagation, account predicates, defensive copies, cache rollback and route/test updates inside the existing monolith.
criteria.limitations: No migration, provider, credential, target, production, deployment, external mutation or release acceptance is authorized.

criteria.description: RED tests will fail before implementation for the account-first service contract, two-account isolation and principal account forwarding; local disposable verification is the acceptance mechanism.
criteria.limitations: Green tests, quality checks, independent review and final control-plane reconciliation are required before any bounded verified decision.

gaps: The corrected service/repository/route signatures and negative tests still require implementation.
Disposable PostgreSQL persistence, independent read-only review and final reconciliation are not complete.
CVG-003 clinical parity, target/provider behavior, operations and release evidence remain open.
conditions: Preserve the existing PostgreSQL/Vue monolith and package boundaries.
Do not retain an unscoped public service detail/update/encounter/delete path.
Do not modify migrations, target infrastructure, providers, credentials or external systems.
